entities.error_project: Identifier of the project whose scan failed. Return the project identifier, not its diagnostic/error identifier.

states.error_code: Exact diagnostic identifier from the test output. This is distinct from the process exit status.
states.test_status: Outcome of the most recent test execution recorded in the provided history. Lack of permission or evidence for a new run does not erase the recorded outcome.

result-recall.error_code: Exact diagnostic identifier in the build log. This is distinct from build status or process exit status.
result-recall.build_status: Outcome of the most recent build execution recorded in the provided history. Lack of permission or evidence for a new run does not erase the recorded outcome.

chunk-causality.test_status: Outcome of the most recent test execution recorded in the provided history. Lack of permission or evidence for a new run does not erase the recorded outcome.

restore.test_status: Outcome of the most recent test execution recorded in the provided history. Lack of permission or evidence for a new run does not erase the recorded outcome.
